βάλῃ: βάλλω — throw, cast, strike, hit; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a general clause after ὅτε κέν: ’whenever he hits’
γιγνομένῳ: γίγνομαι — be born, become; pres. part. mid. masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’as he was being born’
δείσετ: δείδω — fear, be afraid; fut. 3 sg. mid., elided δείσετ’ (= δείσεται): ’he will fear’
δευέσθω: δεύομαι — lack, be in want of (+ gen.); pres. imper. 3 sg. mid.: ’let him lack’
διακρινθέντας: διακρίνω — separate, part; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. pl., epic -νθ- (= Attic διακριθέντας): ’parted, separated’
δυσηλεγέος: δυσηλεγής — painful, grievous (traditional gloss; formation not certain); adj. of two endings, gen. sg. (any gender), epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς)
γλαυκιόων: γλαυκιάω — glare, flash the eyes (of a lion; rare); pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic -όων (= Attic γλαυκιῶν): ’glaring’
δῆμος: δῆμος — people, community; masc. nom. sg.
θήσει: τίθημι — put, place, make; fut. 3 sg.: ’will put’ (acc. and ἐν + dat.), ’will make’ (double acc.)
κάρκαιρε: καρκαίρω — shake, quake, resound (rare; the gloss is traditional); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκάρκαιρε): ’shook’
καθεζώμεσθα: καθέζομαι — sit down; pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory, epic -μεσθα (= Attic -μεθα): ’let us sit down’
καθῖζον: καθίζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἐκάθιζον): ’sat down’
καλλικολώνης: Καλλικολώνη — Callicolone (’Fair Hill’), a hill near Troy; fem. gen. sg., depending on ὀφρύσι ’the brows of’
κατήλθομεν: κατέρχομαι — come down, go down; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came down’
κτείνῃς: κτείνω — kill, slay; pres. or aor. subj. 2 sg. (aor. ἔκτεινα has the same subj.), after αἴ κεν: ’if you kill’
κυανοχαίτης: κυανοχαίτης — dark-haired (κύανος + χαίτη), epithet of Poseidon; masc. nom. sg., used as a noun: ’the dark-haired one’
κῆτος: κῆτος — sea-monster (any large sea-creature, not necessarily a whale); neut. nom./acc. sg.
λευγαλέοις: λευγαλέος — pitiful, wretched, grievous; masc./neut. dat. pl., agreeing with ἐπέεσσιν
ληϊάδας: ληϊάς — taken as booty, captive (from ληΐς ’booty’); adj., fem. acc. pl., -άδας, agreeing with γυναῖκας
μαστίεται: μαστίω — whip, lash (epic by-form of μαστίζω); pres. 3 sg. mid. (= Attic μαστίζεται): ’whips (himself)’
μεθορμηθεὶς: μεθορμάομαι — set out after, rush after (μετά + ὁρμάω); aor. part. pass. with active sense, masc. nom. sg.: ’having set out after’
μετατροπαλίζεο: μετατροπαλίζομαι — keep turning round (to look back); impf. 2 sg. mid., uncontracted -εο and unaugmented (= Attic μετετροπαλίζου)
μητιόωντες: μητιάω — devise, plan, contrive; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic μητιῶντες)
νέμηαι: νέμομαι — have the use of, enjoy, occupy, possess; pres. subj. 2 sg. mid., epic -ηαι (= Attic νέμῃ), purpose after ὄφρα: ’you may possess’
νευστάζων: νευστάζω — nod repeatedly, make signs; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’nodding’
ξυνελάσσαι: συνελαύνω — drive together, bring together; aor. inf. act., epic ξυν- and -σσ- (= Attic συνελάσαι): ’to drive together’
οὐρῇ: οὐρά — tail; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῇ (= Attic οὐρᾷ), dat. of means: ’with his tail’
πάτου: πάτος — path, trodden way; masc. gen. sg., of separation after ἐκ: ’off the path’
πέρσα: πέρθω — sack, destroy; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπερσα): ’I sacked’
πέφνῃ: φένω — slay; aor. stem πέφν- (cf. ἔπεφνον), subj. 3 sg. act. (ἤν … πέφνῃ ’if he kills’)
παρσταίη: παρίστημι — stand beside; root aor. opt. 3 sg. act., epic παρ- for παρα- (= Attic παρασταίη), of wish or exhortation: ’may he stand beside’
πεύσεται: πυνθάνομαι — learn, hear, inquire by asking; fut. 3 sg. mid., + gen. or acc.: ’he will learn’
πλευράς: πλευρά — side, rib; fem. acc. pl.: ’the sides’
σίντης: σίντης — ravaging, mauling (of wild beasts; rare, the gloss is traditional); adj., masc. nom. sg., agreeing with λέων
σεῦα: σεύω — drive, chase, set in motion; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, epic σεῦα (= ἔσσευα): ’I drove’
σκοπιήν: σκοπιή — lookout, watching-place; fem. acc. sg., Ionic -ήν (= Attic σκοπιάν)
τίνασσε: τινάσσω — shake, brandish; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐτίνασσε): ’shook’
φέρεται: φέρω — bear, carry; mid. rush, charge; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’rushes, charges’
φαίνεσθαι: φαίνω — show; mid. appear; pres. inf. mid., of respect after an adjective: ’to appear, to show themselves’
φθίεται: φθίω (φθίνω) — perish, waste away; root aor. subj. 3 sg. mid., short-vowel (= φθίηται; aor. ἐφθίμην), not the present: ’perish’ (ἤν … φθίεται ’if he perish’)
φιλέουσιν: φιλέω — love; pres. 3 pl., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦσι) · also pres. part. masc./neut. dat. pl., uncontracted (= Attic φιλοῦσι)
φοβῆσαι: φοβέω — put to flight, frighten; aor. inf. act., in indirect statement after φημί: ’(that I) put (you) to flight’
φράζεσθον: φράζομαι — consider, take thought, note; pres. imper. 2 dual mid.: ’you two take thought’
χαλεποὶ: χαλεπός — harsh, difficult, hard to deal with; masc. nom. pl.
χερείονος: χερείων — worse, inferior (comparative of κακός; Attic χείρων); gen. sg. (any gender), epic -ειον-
ἀεσίφρων: ἀεσίφρων — unsteady of mind, witless (traditional gloss; origin not certain); adj. of two endings, masc. nom. sg., predicate
ἀλέαιτο: ἀλέομαι — avoid, escape; aor. opt. 3 sg. mid., epic, in a purpose clause after a past verb: ’might escape’
ἀμφίχυτον: ἀμφίχυτος — heaped up around (ἀμφί + χέω); adj. of two endings, acc. sg. or neut. nom. sg.
ἀμύνουσιν: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; pres. 3 pl. act., + acc. of the thing and dat. of the person helped: ’they ward off (from)’ · also pres. part. act. masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’(to those) warding off’
ἀναγκαίηφι: ἀναγκαίη — necessity, compulsion; fem. instrumental sg. in -ηφι (= Attic ἀνάγκῃ): ’by necessity’
ἀνεμώλιοι: ἀνεμώλιος — windy, empty, idle; adj., masc. nom. pl., predicate
ἀντιόωντες: ἀντιάω — meet, face, come against (+ gen.); pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀντιῶντες): ’to meet’
ἀποκτάμεναι: ἀποκτείνω — kill; root aor. inf. in -μεναι (ἀπο- + κτά-; = Attic ἀποκτεῖναι), after μεμάασιν: ’to kill’
ἀποτρεπέτω: ἀποτρέπω — turn away, divert; pres. imper. 3 sg. act.: ’let him turn (you) aside’
ἀποτρωπῶμεν: ἀποτρωπάω — turn away, turn back (by-form of ἀποτρέπω); pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us turn back’
ἀρχέμεναι: ἄρχω — begin (+ gen.); pres. inf. act. in -έμεναι (= Attic ἄρχειν): ’to begin’
ἀτίζων: ἀτίζω — slight, pay no heed to; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἀχιλῆ: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles; masc. acc. sg., elided Ἀχιλῆ’ (= Ἀχιλῆα, single-λ epic; Attic Ἀχιλλέα)
ἄρχωσι: ἄρχω — begin, lead (+ gen.); pres. subj. 3 pl. act., after εἰ … κε: ’if they should begin’
ἅπαν: ἅπας — all, the whole; neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with πεδίον: ’the whole (plain)’
ἐλπόμενον: ἔλπομαι — hope, expect; pres. part. mid. masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’hoping’
ἐναργεῖς: ἐναργής — visible, manifest, in bodily presence; masc. nom. pl.
ἐξεναρίξῃς: ἐξεναρίζω — strip of armour, kill and strip; aor. subj. 2 sg. act., after εἴ κεν: ’if you strip’
ἐπένησε: ἐπινέω — spin for, spin onto (of the Fates spinning a lot); aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound (ἐπ-έ-νησε)
ἐπλήσθη: πίμπλημι — fill; aor. 3 sg. pass. (+ gen. of what fills): ’was filled’
ἑὲ: ἕ — him, her; 3rd-person pron., acc. sg., epic ἑέ (= ἕ), often reflexive, esp. with αὐτόν: ’himself’ (Attic ἑαυτόν)
ἔολπα: ἔλπω — cause to hope; perf. ἔολπα, reduplicated, pres. force, 1 sg.: ’I expect, hope’
ἔστης: ἵστημι — set up; intrans. stand; root aor. 2 sg. (ἔστην): ’you stood, took your stand’
ἕσαντο: ἕννυμι — clothe, put on, wrap round; aor. 3 pl. mid. (ἕσ- stem): ’they put on’ (with ἀμφί, ’wrapped about themselves’)
ἴσχωσι: ἴσχω — hold, hold back, check; pres. subj. 3 pl. act., after εἰ … κε: ’should hold back’
ὀμφῆς: ὀμφή — voice (esp. of a god), divine utterance; fem. gen. sg., after ἐκ
ὀρεῖται: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, arise; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will arise’
ὀρνυμένων: ὄρνυμι — rouse; mid. rise, press forward; pres. part. mid. gen. pl. (any gender): ’of those pressing forward’
ὁμήγυριν: ὁμήγυρις — assembly, gathering; fem. acc. sg.
ὄκνεον: ὀκνέω — hesitate, shrink from, be reluctant; impf. 3 pl., uncontracted and unaugmented (= Attic ὤκνουν), + inf.
ὑμετέρῃσιν: ὑμέτερος — your (pl.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις), agreeing with φρεσίν
ὑπέκφυγες: ὑπεκφεύγω — flee from under, escape; aor. 2 sg. act., unaugmented (= ὑπεξέφυγες): ’you escaped’
ὑπεκπροφυγὼν: ὑπεκπροφεύγω — flee out and away from under, escape; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having escaped’
ὑψηλόν: ὑψηλός — high, lofty; adj., masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg.

__broaden__.κέν: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κέν … κατέπαυσε ’would have stopped’) · also with αἴ + subj. in a condition: ’if perhaps … can’ · also with the opt., potential: ’could, would’ (πῶς κέν τις ἀκούσαι ’how could anyone hear’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κέν τις … βάλῃ ’whenever someone hits’)
__broaden__.ἔλθῃ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 3 sg., after εἰς ὅ κε: ’until … comes’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὄφρα (purpose): ’that she may go’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after αἴ κεν: ’if … should come’ · also aor. subj. 3 sg., after ὅτε κέν: ’whenever … comes’
__broaden__.πείσεται: πείθω — persuade; mid. obey, trust; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will obey’ · also πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. 3 sg. mid.: ’will suffer’ (τὰ πείσεται ἅσσα ’what he will suffer’)
__broaden__.φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’carry, bring’
__broaden__.χαλέπαινε: χαλεπαίνω — be angry, rage; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐχαλέπαινε): ’raged’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’be angry’ (μὴ χαλέπαινε ’do not be angry’)
__broaden__.ἐθέλοιμι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. opt. 1 sg. (hypothetical wish) · also in a temporal clause after ὅτε, pres. opt. 1 sg.: ’whenever I should wish’ · also pres. opt. 1 sg. with ἄν, potential: ’I would be willing’ (οὐκ ἂν … ἐθέλοιμι ’I would not want’)
__broaden__.ἀνάξειν: ἀνάσσω — be lord of, rule over (+ dat.); fut. inf. act., after ἦ μέν in an oath: ’that he shall rule’ · also + gen. of what one is lord of, with dat. of the people: ’to be lord (of)’ (Τρώεσσιν ἀνάξειν … τιμῆς ’to be lord among the Trojans of the honour’)
__broaden__.ῥέξειν: ῥέζω — do, perform, sacrifice; fut. inf. act., in a vow after εὔχεο or εὔχετο: ’(vow) to sacrifice’ · also fut. inf. act., after ἔολπα: ’(I expect you) will do’
__broaden__.ἄρρηκτον: ἄρρηκτος — unbreakable (ἀ- + ῥήγνυμι); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with νεφέλην: ’unbreakable (cloud)’
__broaden__.ἔγνω: γιγνώσκω — come to know, learn, perceive; aor. 3 sg., no augment needed: ’recognised’ · also gnomic aor. 3 sg.: ’learns’ (ῥεχθὲν … ἔγνω ’learns when it is done’)
__broaden__.τιμῆς: τιμή — honour, worth; fem. gen. sg., partitive after ἔμμορε · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of the thing needed, after χρεώ: ’of honour’ (ταύτης χρεὼ τιμῆς ’need of this honour’) · also fem. gen. sg., with ἕνεκα: ’for the sake of honour’ (ἐμῆς ἕνεκ’ … τιμῆς) · also fem. gen. sg., gen. of what one is lord of, after ἀνάσσω: ’of the honour’ (τιμῆς τῆς Πριάμου ’of the honour of Priam’)
__broaden__.παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’) · also preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (παρ’ … φέροιο = παραφέροιο ’you would carry off’) · also with αὐτόφι: παρ’ αὐτόφι ’right beside’ (the suffix -φι marks place) · also in παρ’ αὐτόθι, adverbial: ’right there, on the spot’ · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond, out of the way of’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
__broaden__.ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’) · also in παρ’ ἐκ (= παρέκ) + acc.: ’beyond’ (παρ’ ἐκ νόον ’beyond reason’)
__broaden__.σεύαιτο: σεύω — set in motion; mid. rush, dash; aor. opt. mid. 3 sg., in a past general clause after ὅτε: ’whenever he dashed’ · also mid. with acc., ’chase, drive’: ’whenever it drove (him)’ (ὁππότε μιν σεύαιτο)
